svg.title: Visual abstract: Chromatin accessibility of glioblastoma cells
svg.desc: A Python scATAC-seq workflow (TF-IDF, LSI, Leiden, UMAP, gene activity, differential accessibility and machine learning) applied to 22,873 cells from five glioblastoma patients. Each tumor splits into four to nine chromatin states, patients share conserved programs, and an LSI-based logistic regression reaches about 0.79 balanced accuracy.
svg.text: VISUAL ABSTRACT · SINGLE-CELL EPIGENOMICS · scATAC-seq · GLIOBLASTOMA

spanning tumor, OPC-like and immune compartments that a simple LSI classifier separates reliably.
